headline: Contractors Withdraw From Rockhopper's Sea Lion Oil Project in Malvinas
summary: Rockhopper Exploration informed the London Stock Exchange that UK and Israeli contractors withdrew from the Sea Lion offshore project due to legal and commercial risks linked to Argentine administrative actions.
why: Rockhopper Exploration holds significant offshore licences in the Falkland Islands basin; geopolitical disputes with Argentina impact operator financing and shipyard contracting.

impacts.name: Rockhopper Exploration
impacts.why: Contractor withdrawals and contract cancellation risks delay field development and create legal uncertainty.
